lastMessages:
worker:  only validate, so they return `null` or the error string and no normalised value.

The new tests cover:
- **Email:** a valid address, surrounding whitespace, non-strings (`undefined`, `null`, a number) and malformed strings (`'nope'`, `'a@b'`, `'a b@c.co'`, `''`). They also cover the 254 and 255 boundary, including 254 with whitespace around it.
- **Name:** a normal name, non-strings, `''` and whitespace-only values (all `'name: required'`), and the 80 and 81 boundary. One more test checks a name that is over 80 characters only because of surrounding whitespace.

Git warned that LF line endings will become CRLF in the working copy of both new files. I didn't change any line-ending settings.
